component.name: PlainRun
component.summary: A simple native running log for Linux

description.p: PlainRun records your runs and makes it easy to see how much you have been running. It is small, fast and entirely local: no accounts, no cloud, no tracking.

ul.li: Record date, distance, time, and optionally average heart rate and a note; pace is calculated
Weekly, monthly and yearly totals, with simple distance and beats-per-km charts
Personal bests for 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon
Backup and restore, CSV export and import
Keyboard friendly; follows the Omarchy theme when available

description.p: Record your watch's average heart rate with a run, if you like, and follow beats per km: how many heartbeats each kilometre costs, as a monthly median. In narrow windows, the charts and personal bests are now one keystroke away (Ctrl+T) instead of hidden.
Your data folder and database files are now private to your user account.
